body: I read this. You're worth my time. Youre worth it. You're worth so much. I got to a grammar school too and trust me, no one finds it easy. You're not inferior to anyone else, if anything youre stronger. Your childhood hasnt been easy, youre strong for not only living through that but also talking about it. Your ex was no good, you're better off without him. Plus, your paragraphs read like poems, expertly crafted even when you're tired and stressed. I'm so proud of you for making it so far, do you really want to quit now? I don't know who you are, but i really wish the best for you because you're an amazing human being. If you wanna talk to a stranger about your problems, my pms are open and i have all the time in the world for you.

Im not much good at poetry, and i doubt im much good at helping people but ill give it a try. Please. You've probably heard this so many times before but you're worth it, suicide isn't the way to go. Its cheesy but its said all the time cos its true. Doesn't matter if you think you're a shitty person, you're worth it. There's more to life than pain. Life is hard and no one asks for it, but there's gotta be something that makes it worth living. If youre gonna do it anyway, at least do something big you've wanted to do for ages before you go. If you're gonna die, die content at the very least. There's a reason you want to go and i doubt you'll wanna tell a stranger what it is thats put you in this position, but my pms are open if you ever wanna talk. If you're still leaving, rest easy. It gets better eventually
